Short title, extent and commencement

PLD 2021 Punjab Statutes 420
PLD 2021 Punjab Statutes 420
ORDINANCE XII OF 2021
PUNJAB MUSEUMS BOARD ORDINANCE, 2021
An Ordinance to establish the
Punjab Museums Board
[Gazette of Punjab Extraordinary,
25th March, 2021]
No.
Legis: 13-49/2019, dated 25.3.2021.---The
following Ordinance promulgate by Governor of the Punjab is hereby published
for general information.
It
is necessary to establish the Punjab Museums Board for efficient maintenance
and management of the museums in the Punjab and for the ancillary matters.
Provincial
Assembly of the Punjab is not in session and Governor of the Punjab is
satisfied that circumstances exist which render it necessary to take immediate
action.
In
exercise of the powers conferred under clause (1) of Article 128 of
Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, Governor of the Punjab is
pleased to make and promulgate the following Ordinance:
1. Short
title, extent and commencement.---(1)
This Ordinance may be cited as the Punjab Museums Board Ordinance, 2021.
(2) It
extends to whole of the Punjab.
(3) It
shall apply to such museums as the Government may, by notification, in the
official Gazette, specify from time to time.

Definitions

2. Definitions.---In this Ordinance:
(a) "Board"
means the Punjab Museums Board established under section 3 of this Ordinance;
(b) "CEO"
means the Chief Executive Officer of the Board;
(c) "Chairperson"
means the Chairperson of the Board;
(d) "committee"
means a committee constituted under this Ordinance;
(e) "Government"
means Government of the Punjab;
(f) "member"
means a member of the Board;
(g) "museum"
means a museum notified under this Ordinance;
(h) "prescribed"
means prescribed by the rules or the regulations made or framed under this
Ordinance;
(i) "regulations"
means the regulations framed under this Ordinance; and
(j) "rules"
means the rules made under this Ordinance.

3. Board.---(1) The Government shall, by notification in the
official Gazette, establish a Board to be known as the Punjab Museums Board for
carrying out the purposes of this Ordinance.
(2) The
Board shall be a body corporate having perpetual succession and a common seal
with power to enter into contracts and to acquire and hold property, movable
and immovable, and may in its name sue and be sued.

Composition of the Board

4. Composition
of the Board.---(1) The Board
shall consist of the Chairperson to be nominated by the Chief Minister,
Secretary to the Government Tourism Department as Vice Chairperson, and the
following members:
(a) Secretary
to the Government, Planning and Development Department or his representative
not below the rank of an Additional Secretary;
(b) Secretary
to the Government, Finance Department or his representative not below the rank
of an Additional Secretary;
(c) Secretary
to the Government, Information and Culture Department or his representative not
below the rank of an Additional Secretary;
(d) Director
General Archaeology of the Government;
(e) one
member of Provincial Assembly of the Punjab to be nominated by the Chief
Minister;
(f) five
persons from the private sector, including at least one woman, having expertise
preferably in the fields of Museology, History, Anthropology, Art History or
Archaeology, Cultural and Heritage Management, Financial Administration or
Marketing.
(2) The
members at clause (f) of subsection (1) shall be nominated by the Chief
Minister on the recommendations of the Minister-in-Charge and Secretary to the
Government, Tourism Department for a renewable term of three years.
(3) A
non-official member shall not be entitled to any remuneration, and he may
resign from his office by tendering his resignation to the Chief Minister.
(4) The
Board may co-opt any person for efficient transaction of its business in the
meetings, but such person shall not have right to vote.

of non-official members.---The
Chief Minister may remove a non-official member if :
(a) has
been adjudged an undischarged insolvent; or
(b) has
been convicted of an offence which involves moral turpitude; or
(c) has
become physically or mentally incapable of acting as the CEO or the member; or
(d) has
abused his position and rendered his continuance in the office prejudicial to
public interest.

(2) The

(3) The
CEO shall hold office during the pleasure of the Chief Minister.

as may be prescribed by the regulations.
(2) The quorum for a meeting shall be
one third of the total members, the fraction being counted as one.
(3) Each
member shall have one vote and in case of equality of votes the person
presiding over the meeting shall have a casting vote.

8. Powers
and function of the Board.---The
Board shall:
(a) formulate
policies, plans and programs for protection, maintenance and management of the
museum;
(b) manage
and regulate the finance, accounts and investments of the museum;
(c) determine
the terms and conditions of service of the CEO and other employees of the
Board;
(d) ensure
adequate and effective governance and risk management system in the Authority;
(e) promote
and develop partnerships with other organizations;
(f) enter
into contracts in conformity with the purposes of this Ordinance;
(g) approve
annual accounts, budget and estimates of expenditure;
(h) lend
any object of the museum for public exhibition;
(i) set
up such committees as may be required for the purposes of this Ordinance;
(j) frame
regulations for the conduct of business of the Board;
(k) formulate
procedure and necessary framework for utilization of funds generated or
acquired through donations or grants;
(l) provide
researchers the access to antiquities;
(m) impart
training in the field of Museology;
(n) hold
conferences, symposiums, seminars, workshops with respect to Archaeology,
Museology and other relevant subjects;
(o) collaborate
with world museums for exchange of relevant expertise; and
(p) perform
any other functions and exercise such powers as may be ancillary to the above,
or as may be assigned by the Government from time to time.

(3) There

such manner and having such functions as may be prescribed.

(a) all

(b) grants

(c) loans
obtained from the Government or the Federal Government;
(d) loans
raised by the Board with the special or general sanction of the Government;
(e) foreign
aid and loans obtained by the Board with the sanction of the Government;
(f) fees
and other sums received by the Board; and
(g) contribution
and donations from individuals, local bodies, corporations, institutions,
organizations and agencies.
(2) The
Fund shall be kept in such custody, utilized and regulated in such manner as
may be prescribed by the rules.

report shall consist of:
(a) the
statement of accounts and audit reports of the museum;
(b) a
comprehensive statement of the work and activities of the museum during the
preceding financial year and its proposed projects and schemes; and
(c) such
other matters as may be prescribed or as the Board may consider appropriate.
(3) The
Government shall, within two months of receiving the report from the Board,
shall lay the report in the first available session of the Assembly.

annually audit the accounts of the Board.
(2) The
Government, in addition to the audit under subsection (1), may cause the
accounts of the Board annually audited by a Chartered Accountant or a firm of
Chartered Accountants.
(3) The
auditor appointed under subsection (2) shall be provided such access to the
books, accounts and other documents as may be considered necessary for the
audit of accounts.
(4) The
auditor shall submit the audit report to the Board, and the Board shall submit
the report to the Government along with its own observations thereof.
